title: Fully Funded PhD in Machine Learning for Scientific Discovery at Princeton University 2027
intro: Princeton University's Vertaix lab invites applications for fully funded PhD positions in machine learning for scientific discovery, starting Fall 2027.
description:
**About the Project**

The Vertaix lab at Princeton Computer Science, led by Prof. Adji Bousso Dieng, invites applications for fully funded PhD positions starting Fall 2027. The research builds the foundations of Investigative Intelligence, moving AI beyond simple predictive pattern matching toward systems capable of autonomous scientific discovery. The group tackles challenges including high-dimensional space exploration, mode collapse mitigation, and spectral diversity for trustworthy AI systems.

**Research Areas**

- Machine learning for scientific discovery
- Investigative Intelligence
- Generative models and mode collapse
- Spectral diversity and trustworthy AI
- AI for the natural sciences
